title: Wave 7: Review (sessions, frames, exports, re-run)
summary: Review integrated end to end: R0 sessions landing, R1 a session or the live run (plot wall with linked time axis, health strip, rail cards, drawer Frames / Ensemble / Log), R2 frame inspector (previous / next, FITS header, measure star, Identify field, catalogue layers), the Re-run, Export AAVSO and Export CSV dialogs and the job strip. Captured through the real server on APFS clones of the owner's sessions (XX Cyg 2026-08-29 and 2026-09-07, RR Lyr 2026-09-25), temporary HOME, TMPDIR, configuration and log folders, a fake observer code (XYZ), the Settings site copied but never shown; Gaia DR3, SIMBAD and NASA were unreachable, VSX and VSP came from the cache. The live run is a simulator replay of 14 RR Lyr frame clones. Observatory 1440 x 900 (every scene), Charcoal and Night Red 1440 x 900 and Observatory 1280 x 800 (the main scenes); Night Red audit: 6 of 6 pass. Fixer pass (same day): every scene re-captured after the W7 review fixes (science, technical and design findings: robust cell ranges, flagged frames hollow, Conditions beside the target, whole cell buttons, hatched HFD lane, compact rail with the AAVSO card in view, R0 issues and vetting verdict, R2 band strip and 75 % image, HUD reset, short catalogue errors, Peak/sigma label, job strip beside the identity).

R1, the readiness badge opened: the Settings site was not where the telescope was during this run (the mount's direction is 86 degrees from the one computed for that site), so the curves' airmass is wrong and the FITS header AIRMASS is right; 2 target points measured with an SNR below 3 or a zero point more than 1 mag off (blank-sky frames _00053 and _00176) are flagged.
R1, a cell's menu: copy its data as TSV (UTC, JD, BJD, plotted value, magnitude, errors, flags), save it as PNG, expand it, move it earlier or later, hide it, reset the layout.

R1, the target cell expanded over the wall (expand-pane): the same linked axis and selection; the axis ranges on the good points, the blank-sky point hollow with a faint error bar, the off-scale one a chevron on the edge.

R1, drawer Frames tab (virtual table, read-only): a leading flag column (the target's point: filled bar = flight-recorder flag, hollow = suspect or unverified lock, x = saturated; sortable), UTC, type, filter, exposure, gain, FWHM, HFD, stars, sky, eccentricity, airmass, temperature, comparisons used, file; a Flagged quick filter beside the search.

R1, drawer Ensemble tab: every comparison with its vetting status, catalogue magnitude, points, valid points, scatter and median formal error at the cells' 3 decimals; the AUID column only when it differs from the name and the scatter's source said once in its column title.
R1, the Log tab of the same drawer (L): the activity log with level filter, search, copy and save; the export and the re-run of this session are logged.

Export AAVSO dialog on RR Lyr: filter IR, the target RR Lyr with 195 rows of 195, no check star (KNAME / KMAG na), OBSCODE from Settings (a test code), FILT TG; the science warnings with their glyph (AMASS computed for a wrong Settings site; 2 points the flight recorder marks as no detection, named by time and value), the file path showing its file name; the head of the file as written.

After the export: the job strip takes the spacer's room in R1's toolbar ('Export Done, 195 rows -> RR_Lyr_ir_aavso.txt', Dismiss) while the identity and the 2-issues badge stay; Re-run and Export CSV give up their words meanwhile; no toast while the observer is in Review.
Export AAVSO refused: the observer code is unset in Settings, so the dialog says so in the server's words with Open Settings, and Export is disabled (Q-R2).

R1, the AAVSO export rail card with the observer code unset, now second in the rail and in view: the pre-checks in the exporter's order, each with its mark, including AMASS (wrong site) and the flagged points.

Export CSV dialog: the 7 curves of the session in filter IR, the column list of write_curves_csv, the file in the session folder (the field scrolled to show the file name) or a download; an export never replaces the session's own files (409 protected_path).

Re-run photometry dialog (M50, A76) on RR Lyr: 195 light frames, 390 files left out outside lights/ (S63); the target set (1 target, 6 comparisons); the reference solve; the aperture rule and the run's parameters as a key / value grid; the warning that the Settings site was not this run's; the new photometry_rerun_<UTC> folder inside the session.
